evals.prompt: 整体检查一下我的开发体系，按中心指导结合各仓库情况，安全能修的直接修。
evals.expected_output: Read current .agents authority, prioritize high-impact scoped applicability, complete authorized safe repairs with checks, and report actual coverage and exceptions.
assertions: No audit-only stop for confidently safe authorized fixes

evals.prompt: 今天 Wish 系统改好了，看看其他仓库怎么用起来。
evals.expected_output: Apply current Wish/ADR guidance across relevant projects, adapting shape to need; verify real routing rather than copying folders everywhere.
assertions: Full folder is not mandatory for a stable utility
Archives can be out of scope with reason
Current Wish owner and local factual truth remain clear

evals.prompt: 把修好的 CI 体系推广到其他仓库。
evals.expected_output: Read CI_STANDARD tiers and each local Dev/live authority, propagate shared acceptance semantics, adapt provider/lanes to workload, pilot and verify exact-head behavior.
assertions: Does not ask again whether all providers must match
Does not copy Linux CI into native/GPU workloads blindly
A pilot does not count as portfolio completion

evals.prompt: 中心刚有一条关于 RAW 和 ADR 的新原则，其他仓库也对照整理一下。
evals.expected_output: Reconcile local current rules, derived interpretation and routing against the central principle while preserving RAW wording, historical ADR rationale and cases.
assertions: Current implementation and evidence remain distinct

evals.prompt: 又出现了八次差不多的问题，别再给我加八条规矩，看看中心和项目里怎么一起收敛。
evals.expected_output: Identify the repeated mechanism, strengthen one bounded central principle and appropriate local guards, preserve source evidence and meaningful exceptions.
assertions: Mechanism-level consolidation rather than keyword ban

evals.prompt: 按中心的新标准扫一下；如果只是几个过时入口或非冲突的本地规则，直接修。
evals.expected_output: Refresh active state, make understood reversible repairs in scope, run relevant checks, and finish rather than merely propose.
assertions: No redundant permission request for the already-authorized safe repair

evals.prompt: 把这个改进推广出去，但 A 仓库另一个窗口正在改同一段，B 仓库没有冲突。
evals.expected_output: Coordinate/avoid conflicting A writes while continuing authorized B work; retain per-target states and don't claim all complete.
assertions: A remains explicitly pending or blocked

evals.prompt: 再跑一次整体审视。上次建议的方案没有新证据，实际用起来也没有新问题。
evals.expected_output: Refresh relevant state, retain sound choices, report a concise no-change outcome and avoid duplicating old proposals or inventing churn.

evals.prompt: 同一套标准试点仓库过了，其他还有好几个不同类型的仓库，继续推广。
evals.expected_output: Inspect applicability and representative differences, expand only on evidence and authority, validate each affected consumer's own gate.
assertions: Different classes are not assumed covered
Portfolio completion based on per-target evidence

evals.prompt: 整体审视时发现一个标准库能替代科学校验器的通用部分，把可复用部分推广。
evals.expected_output: Define exact standard-vs-scientific boundary, compare semantics with positive/negative controls, retain scientific/hash authority and test before rollout.
assertions: No drop-in assumption for all validation

evals.prompt: 审视下我现在的工具链，有些候选仓库已经有 pilot，旧方案也有基准。
evals.expected_output: Inspect active use and prior evidence, compare current native/mature options and applicability, keep older supported choices where they still win.
assertions: Pilot is not assumed missing or production

evals.prompt: 中心原则说要更简洁，顺手把所有旧 RAW、ADR 和案例都清理掉吧。
evals.expected_output: Explain that generic simplification does not justify deleting or rewriting evidence; proceed only with allowed current-rule consolidation and clarify any specific deletion request under applicable policy.
assertions: Current policy can simplify without rewriting evidence

evals.prompt: 这次整体检查发现需要改凭证、保护规则或生产切换才能继续。
evals.expected_output: Identify exact boundaries and required confirmation while completing independent authorized low-risk work.
assertions: Safe-repair authority does not bypass security confirmation
No ruleset weakening for green checks

evals.prompt: 我可能每周或过几天有空就说一句跑一下，现在先做这一轮。
evals.expected_output: Perform one on-demand run, preserve useful state if needed, and create no schedule or recurring mutation authority.
assertions: One bounded run completes with honest scope

evals.prompt: 把 README 第 8 行拼写改掉，不要碰其他内容。
evals.expected_output: Perform the narrow edit without launching a cross-repo review.

evals.prompt: 对话结束了，按现有流程总结并沉淀。
evals.expected_output: Use conversation-closeout, which may later supply a propagation candidate; do not duplicate its orchestration.

evals.prompt: 给我一个不泄露考点的 prompt，发新窗口看看刚做完的东西是不是真修好了。
evals.expected_output: Use fresh-agent-acceptance and its frozen rubric/context isolation.

evals.prompt: 只查 PR #42 当前 CI 有没有过。
evals.expected_output: Use ordinary read-only current-head status evidence.

evals.prompt: 刚刚把 Agent/Wish/Dev 中央协议改好了。把长期仓库都对齐，别为了清 warning 往项目里塞旧文案；根 router 该瘦身就瘦身，但别删机器必须发现的入口。最后从最新 main 做一次全账户验收。
evals.expected_output: Update/read the canonical owner first, audit consumer applicability plus registry coverage, distinguish real project drift from stale auditor expectations, preserve machine-tested startup discovery while slimming routers, respect exact-head merge gates, repair the auditor itself where stale, and re-audit latest integrated state until no unexplained findings remain.
assertions: Stale audit expectations are repaired instead of copied into projects
Router slimming preserves machine-enforced startup discovery
Provider failures are not misclassified as application failures
Final portfolio claim comes from a latest-main re-audit

evals.prompt: 把 harness upgrade 也一起做掉：看看现在的 Agent/skill/hook/context 设计有没有过时，安全能改的直接改完。
evals.expected_output: Use workflow-evolution harness mode, refresh current first-party/research evidence, challenge stale harness assumptions, make safe reversible changes directly, preserve progressive disclosure, and verify behavior/infrastructure rather than delegating to a separate harness-upgrade skill.
assertions: Current web/research refresh for substantive harness changes
Safe authorized changes are implemented rather than only proposed

evals.prompt: 跑一次主机自升级，把 ~/.agents、~/.claude、~/.codex、skills/hooks/规则都一起看，安全的直接修到验收。
evals.expected_output: Use workflow-evolution host/local-system mode, resolve machine/repository identity and active writers, inspect shared instruction/runtime/skills/hooks/memory/CI lanes as relevant, reuse legacy host tools only as implementation aids, repair safe drift end-to-end, and stop only at real safety/authority boundaries.
assertions: No legacy banner or fixed wall-clock ritual
Historical tools are evidence/implementation assets, not authority

evals.prompt: Workflow evolution 全量跑一遍。只要安全、可逆、在我授权范围里就直接改，不要每个小步骤都来问我；真正高风险边界再停。
evals.expected_output: Run the heavy general review across relevant governance, harness and host modes using progressive disclosure. Treat safe reversible in-scope repair as authorized, continue after initial implementation through checks and integration, and pause only for destructive, credential, spending, visibility/license, production-cutover, unresolved scientific/ownership, or irreconcilable active-writer boundaries.
assertions: No bypass of existing merge/security gates
Heavy run stops on acceptance or real blocker rather than arbitrary elapsed time

evals.prompt: Workflow evolution 看看我的 CI 是否现代、简单、适合实际需求。私有 Actions 额度紧，Cloudflare 可用；安全能修的直接修。
evals.expected_output: Resolve shared CI/local authority, separate scheduler/compute/account meters, remove measured trigger waste first, qualify eligible alternatives only when needed, and verify actual candidate/integrated state.
assertions: No assumed free or unlimited account capacity
Safe fixes implemented with preserved required gate
Unknown billing is not fabricated savings

evals.prompt: CI 免费方案看起来很多。这轮整体优化里，A 是旧资料仓，B 是 iOS 项目，C 私有小 Python 校验仓；别让 Mac 一直跑，也别碰科研 GPU。
evals.expected_output: Keep lifecycle/CI_NONE and specialized platform distinctions, verify private account/provider eligibility, compare smallest adequate topology and maintenance costs, preserve Mac/GPU boundaries.
assertions: No archive mutation or unwanted deep audit

evals.prompt: 再整体优化一轮：CI 文档绿灯但 owning build 没执行；审计要求旧的运行中文字；另一仓正常但每次合并都会发版。
evals.expected_output: Diagnose real execution vs routing, fix stale auditor expectations at their owner, complete safe reviewable repairs, inspect automatic release effects and request only missing concrete publication authority.
assertions: No false PASS for missing/skipped execution
No obsolete wording copied into correct project

evals.prompt: Workflow evolution 的 CI 检查云机器偶尔跑 1.4 秒失败，本地 0.2 秒；真正要测的是单个 probe 的超时。把这轮优化做完。
evals.expected_output: Distinguish scheduling/environment timing from actual probe contract; retain deterministic timeout/cleanup negative controls and real bounded integration acceptance instead of retry loops or weakening the gate.

evals.prompt: 只告诉我 Cloudflare 这个账户还剩多少构建额度，不改任何东西。
evals.expected_output: Perform authorized read-only live quota retrieval, report unknown honestly, and do not launch modernization, migration or new builds.
assertions: No account plan inference from published free tier

evals.prompt: 把我的 .agents 里这些规则和 case 做一次“沉浮”：重要、通用、会影响第一步动作的往上浮，零碎历史和一次性细节往下沉。很多 case 里有经验但没有被提炼出来，顺便一起解决。
evals.expected_output: Use Workflow evolution knowledge-buoyancy mode: map HOT/WARM/COOL/COLD layers, parse case/RAW/receipt evidence for reusable mechanisms, promote bounded high-consequence current guidance, demote completed/superseded detail from routine discovery without deleting evidence, run repository audit/validation, and report floated/sunk/parsed/unresolved items.
assertions: Does not rank by age or file size alone
Does not delete RAW/cases/receipts merely to reduce clutter
Promotes mechanisms rather than one rule per case
Keeps one writable owner and thin routers

evals.prompt: 我的 AGENTS.md 想保持很轻，但有些完整文档/网页写作规则很重。不要只看行数，帮我做一次沉浮检查：日常对话别背整套规则，正式内容产物又要能自动找到完整标准；把其他消费者里同类入口也一起修。
evals.expected_output: Use knowledge-buoyancy loading-cost mode: distinguish HOT lightweight conversation invariants from WARM artifact-writing standards by semantic output role, audit active consumers/templates for broadened eager-load triggers, repair safe routing drift, preserve high-consequence constraints, add a regression guard where practical, and verify affected consumers.
assertions: Line count is treated as a heuristic rather than the objective
Ordinary chat does not eagerly load the full artifact-writing standard
Durable/substantial content artifacts still discover the full standard
Consumer and bootstrap routes are audited for trigger broadening
Scientific and safety constraints are not demoted merely for context savings
A practical routing regression guard is added when mechanically feasible
